items.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
items.description: At least 69 people were killed and dozens injured in the collision south of the capital, Madrid.

items.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
items.description: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy have been checked for explosives following separate threats.

items.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
items.description: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.

items.title: NTSB says crucial plane parts found three miles from Florida crash site
items.description: The NTSB said because the parts were found far from the accident site, they fell off before the crash.

items.title: Libya's top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes
items.description: The US company was named after the Greek goddess of victory, so the Dar al-Ifta said displaying its logo was unIslamic.

items.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
items.description: Supermarkets have reported problems from Estonia and Sweden to Portugal and Italy and many retainers have been forced to discard food.

items.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
items.description: At least 38 people are killed in 24 hours and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky warns dozens more could be trapped under rubble.

items.title: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections
items.description: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.

items.title: Indian tourist killed after two helicopters collide near Everest base camp
items.description: The two aircraft crashed just metres from the ground after trying to land at the same spot.

items.title: Irish Olympian Ciara Mageean was a 'talented and inspirational human being'
items.description: The former European champion and two-time Olympic runner had been diagnosed with stage four bowel cancer.

items.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision
items.description: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies aged 30 after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.

items.title: US urges Venezuela to release remaining political prisoners
items.description: The US secretary of state also discusses laying the groundwork for 'free, fair, and credible elections'.
